scope: Remove only CSS declarations with no generated markup or property consumers. No renderer logic, state selection, runtime, data or screenshots changed.
why_layout_is_unchanged: The removed custom property has no var() or JavaScript property consumers. No rendered-element selector or consumed CSS property changed. The published HTML differs only by removal of that declaration inside style.
hash_method: source_sha256_lf normalizes CRLF to LF. worktree_sha256 hashes the exact local bytes. before_source_sha256_lf hashes the published Git blob with the same normalization.
validation_limits: Static source/consumer inspection and exact artifact comparison only. Renderer/browser tests and screenshots were not rerun because removed declarations cannot match/affect the produced HTML. No Docker, Spark, service or operation executed.
